title: Rav Huna of Sura
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Zevachim 91a and Keritot 10a. Hyman reports that Shitah Mekubbetzet and Dikdukei Soferim read Rav Chanina of Sura in Zevachim. He also cites the Rosh, Hilkhot Ketanot, Hilkhot Mezuzah 10, where he disagrees with the Rabbis on Rava’s words.
